'''Xalto Sneerzick''' was the leader of the [[Droid Abolitionist Movement]]. He had the back of his [[Limb/Legends|hand]] decorated with a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of a [[Color/Legends|purple]] cog being struck by a lightning bolt, signifying his devotion to freeing all [[Droid/Legends|droids]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="AJ9" />
